title: The Late-Fee Lookback Window on Home Comfort Financing Accounts
content:
**Fee desk memo — the late-fee lookback (Home Comfort Financing).**

The late-fee lookback is the span of time, counted back from the date of handling, within which earlier late fees on a Home Comfort Financing account are counted. It is fixed as follows:

> The late-fee lookback covers late fees posted less than 12 whole months before the date of handling; where a late fee reversal was posted less than 12 whole months before the date of handling, it instead covers late fees posted less than as many whole months before the date of handling as have passed since the most recent late fee reversal; where no late fee reversal was posted in that time and the account funded at least 36 whole months before the date of handling, it covers late fees posted less than 6 whole months before the date of handling.

## Input — judgement — output

| Account records show | Lookback covers late fees posted less than … before the date of handling |
|---|---|
| a late-fee reversal posted less than 12 whole months before the date of handling | as many whole months as have passed since the most recent late-fee reversal |
| no late-fee reversal in those 12 whole months, and the account funded at least 36 whole months before the date of handling | 6 whole months |
| no late-fee reversal in those 12 whole months, and the account funded fewer than 36 whole months before the date of handling | 12 whole months |

The reversal test is read first: an account with a recent late-fee reversal takes the reversal-based span whatever its age.

## Worked cases (hypothetical accounts)

1. *Recent reversal.* The most recent late-fee reversal was posted 4 whole months (and some days) before the date of handling. The lookback covers late fees posted less than 4 whole months before the date of handling; a late fee posted 5 months earlier falls outside it.
2. *Reversal within the last month.* The most recent late-fee reversal was posted less than one whole month before the date of handling. No whole month has passed since it, so no earlier late fee falls within the lookback.
3. *Older account, no reversal.* No late-fee reversal in the last 12 whole months; the account funded 40 whole months before the date of handling. The lookback covers late fees posted less than 6 whole months before.
4. *Younger account, no reversal.* No late-fee reversal in the last 12 whole months; the account funded 30 whole months before. The lookback covers late fees posted less than 12 whole months before.
5. *Age boundary.* Funded exactly 36 whole months before the date of handling, no reversal: at least 36, so the 6-month span applies. Funded 35 whole months before: the 12-month span applies.
6. *Reversal boundary.* The most recent late-fee reversal was posted exactly 12 whole months before the date of handling: that is not less than 12, so it does not set the span; the account's age decides between 6 and 12 whole months.
